[[Bansheh, Gatherer of Branches]] is a [[Harpy]] [[boss]] that can be found in [[Resplendent Makuun]].

== Locations ==
* [[Vabbi]]
** {{NPC location|Resplendent Makuun}} (see notes)

== Skills ==
(20 [[Marksmanship]] in [[hard mode]])
* {{skill icon|Determined Shot}}
* {{skill icon|Distracting Shot}}
* {{skill icon|Expert's Dexterity}} ([[elite]])
* {{skill icon|Favorable Winds}}
* {{skill icon|Screaming Shot}}

== Items dropped ==
* [[Bansheh's Longbow]] ([[unique]])

== Notes ==
* Will not spawn until the quest [[Brains or Brawn]] is completed
* Bansheh, Gatherer of Branches may not spawn if the quests [[Worst. Performance. Ever.]], or [[Deactivating N.O.X.]] are active.
* In hard mode, Expert's Dexterity does not increase its Marksmanship rank by two (i.e. 20 to 22), since [[attribute]]s are [[Effect stacking|capped]] at rank 20.
{{bug| Sometimes Bansheh, Gatherer of Branches will not spawn even if the above quests are not active.}}
